title: Sample: 蚵仔煎 · 殺價 Haggle · Beginner

lines.name: 馬克
lines.zh: 阿姨您好！我要兩份蚵仔煎，可以嗎？
lines.pinyin: ā yí nín hǎo! wǒ yào liǎng fèn é zǎi jiān, kě yǐ ma?
lines.en: Hello, auntie! I'd like two oyster omelets, is that okay?

lines.name: 阿美姨
lines.zh: 可以喔，帥哥！兩份的話，我算你便宜一點。
lines.pinyin: kě yǐ o, shuài gē! liǎng fèn de huà, wǒ suàn nǐ pián yi yì diǎn.
lines.en: Of course, handsome! Since it's two plates, I'll give you a small discount.

lines.name: 馬克
lines.zh: 真的嗎？太好了！謝謝阿姨，您人真好喔！
lines.pinyin: zhēn de ma? tài hǎo le! xiè xiè ā yí, nín rén zhēn hǎo o!
lines.en: Really? That's great! Thank you, auntie, you're so nice!

lines.name: 阿美姨
lines.zh: 不客氣啦！我的甜酸醬很好吃喔。要加辣醬嗎？
lines.pinyin: bú kè qì la! wǒ de tián suān jiàng hěn hǎo chī o. yào jiā là jiàng ma?
lines.en: You're welcome! My sweet-and-sour sauce is really good. Do you want spicy sauce?

lines.name: 馬克
lines.zh: 好啊！一份加辣，一份不用，謝謝喔！
lines.pinyin: hǎo a! yí fèn jiā là, yí fèn bú yòng, xiè xiè o!
lines.en: Sure! One with chili sauce, one without, thanks!

lines.name: 阿美姨
lines.zh: 好喔！一份辣、一份不辣，對吧？帥哥稍等一下喔，馬上就好！
lines.pinyin: hǎo o! yí fèn là, yí fèn bú là, duì ba? shuài gē shāo děng yí xià o, mǎ shàng jiù hǎo!
lines.en: Okay! One spicy, one not spicy, right? Handsome guy, wait a moment, it'll be ready soon!

lines.name: 馬克
lines.zh: 對對，沒錯喔！請問總共多少錢呢？
lines.pinyin: duì duì, méi cuò o! qǐng wèn zǒng gòng duō shǎo qián ne?
lines.en: Yes, that's right! How much is it altogether?

lines.name: 阿美姨
lines.zh: 兩份原本160塊啦！因為你買兩份，我便宜10塊，150喔！
lines.pinyin: liǎng fèn yuán běn 160 kuài la! yīn wèi nǐ mǎi liǎng fèn, wǒ pián yi 10 kuài, 150 o!
lines.en: Two plates are 160, but since you buy two, I take off 10 — 150 total!

lines.name: 馬克
lines.zh: 150塊，好便宜喔！錢在這裡，謝謝阿姨，再見！
lines.pinyin: 150 kuài, hǎo pián yi o! qián zài zhè lǐ, xiè xiè ā yí, zài jiàn!
lines.en: 150 dollars, what a great deal! Here's the money, thank you auntie, goodbye!

lines.name: 阿美姨
lines.zh: 謝謝帥哥！慢走喔，下次再來吃喔！
lines.pinyin: xiè xiè shuài gē! màn zǒu o, xià cì zài lái chī o!
lines.en: Thank you, handsome! Take care, and come back again!
